prose: The Wall Street Journal reports Anthropic's IPO prospectus shows H1 2026 revenue of $16.3 billion, about 20% of it from two customers, against $1.1 billion in H1 2025, alongside an $80.7 billion net loss driven by accounting charges. The article is paywalled and could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline figures.
highlights: ~20% of revenue concentrated in two customers
$80.7B net loss driven by accounting charges
Source: Anissa Gardizy, WSJ, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the WSJ article is paywalled and the fetch failed during a mass outage.
